selection.note: Read before scoring (7 Oct 2026): candidates are the four rungs S2 names (TF-IDF, X2: bar 0.80; SBERT weak, X4: bar 0.90); a candidate qualifies if its own Recall@50 point estimate meets its group's bar. A qualifying candidate is beaten when a dearer qualifying candidate is 'justified' over it on a registered comparison (K1, K3, or K4 with B and A swapped, since SBERT weak is the dearer side). K2 and K5 decide nothing. The cheapest qualifying candidate not beaten is adopted.
